"""Main-owned lint comparison for the isolated upstream stream recovery port."""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-upstream-v0143-stream-recovery-20261012')
BASE = W.parent / 'perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result


m = module('current_update_lint_owner', O)
leg = module('current_update_lint_findings', B / 'latest-update-mandatory-lints-cpp-v4.py')
leg.W, leg.P, leg.U = W, BASE, BASE
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',
           TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', MYPY_CACHE_DIR='/dev/null', RUFF_OUTPUT_FORMAT='concise')

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-update-server-lints-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))}, evidence={})

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, root=W, allowed=(0,), wall=300):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, root, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 8 + 60,
                             rss_cap=16 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return c, so.read_text(), se.read_text()

    try:
        baseline_receipt = B / 'main-current-update-server-baseline-root-v1/record.json'
        baseline = json.loads(baseline_receipt.read_text())
        assert baseline['passed'] and baseline['complete'] and not baseline['active']
        r['baseline_receipt'] = dict(path=str(baseline_receipt), sha256=m.sha(baseline_receipt))
        report = B / 'research-20261009/implementation-upstream-v0143-stream-recovery-source-v1.txt'
        assert report.is_file()
        r['implementation_report'] = dict(path=str(report), sha256=m.sha(report), agent_final_received=True)
        _, so, _ = run('changed-source', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD', '--', 'serve'])
        _, extra, _ = run('new-source', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', 'serve'])
        files = sorted(set(so.splitlines() + extra.splitlines()))
        assert files and all(p.startswith('serve/') and p.endswith('.py') for p in files)
        r['changed_source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in files}
        assert not run('engine-unchanged', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD', '--', 'src', 'include',
                                          'CMakeLists.txt', 'setup.py', 'cmake', 'third_party'])[1].strip()
        link = W / '.lint'
        if not link.exists():
            link.symlink_to(L, target_is_directory=True)
        assert link.resolve() == L.resolve()
        existing = [p for p in files if (BASE / p).is_file()]
        maps = {}
        for name in existing:
            maps[name] = {}
            before, after = (BASE / name).read_text().splitlines(), (W / name).read_text().splitlines()
            for a, z, count in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, before, after, autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks():
                for i in range(count):
                    maps[name][z + i + 1] = a + i + 1
        bc, bso, bse = run('baseline-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *existing], BASE, (0, 1))
        cc, cso, cse = run('candidate-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files], allowed=(0, 1))
        for tool in ('flake8', 'ruff', 'mypy', 'codespell', 'reuse'):
            assert '== ' + tool in bso and '== ' + tool in cso, tool
        assert 'skipped (' not in bso + cso and 'possible secret' not in bso + cso
        assert not cso.split('== reuse\n')[-1].strip()
        before = leg.findings(bso + '\n' + bse)
        after = leg.findings(cso + '\n' + cse, maps)
        added = sorted(set(after) - set(before), key=repr)
        r['comparison'] = dict(baseline_exit=bc['exit_code'], candidate_exit=cc['exit_code'],
                               baseline=before, candidate=after, added=added)
        save()
        assert not added, added
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['changed_source_pins'].items())
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
